comment: Demo runs for FreeFlux add-object editing (ICCV 2025, wtybest/FreeFlux). n_steps=50 and derive_step=7 match paper defaults. Omit 'source_image' for generated-image mode; include it for real-image mode.

runs.name: cat_yarn_generated
runs.source_prompt: a cat sitting on a wooden floor
runs.target_prompt: a cat sitting on a wooden floor with a ball of yarn near it

runs.name: dog_ball_generated
runs.source_prompt: a yellow dog sitting on grass
runs.target_prompt: a yellow dog sitting on grass with a ball near it

runs.name: car_cone_generated
runs.source_prompt: a red sports car parked on a road
runs.target_prompt: a red sports car parked on a road with a traffic cone beside it

runs.name: bird_feeder_generated
runs.source_prompt: a small bird perched on a tree branch
runs.target_prompt: a small bird perched on a tree branch with a bird feeder nearby
